item.title: 19 Aug — Gibraltar carves its own prediction‑market lane
item.description: ## Gibraltar prediction‑markets regulation live Gibraltar published and activated the world’s first standalone Prediction Market Regulations (LN 176 of 2026) on 13 July 2026. They separate prediction‑market authorisation from gambling licences, define permissible contract types, liquidity rules, exposure and cooling‑off controls, and allow stablecoins in markets.
